notes:
Blank unused Chromebooks (new section, “Blank it when nobody is using the Chromebook”)

Set the number of days, for example 60. A Chromebook counts as used on the last day Google saw someone active on it, or its last check-in if that’s all Google has.
Preview unused shows what would be blanked and why. Blank assigned users on unused ones makes the change after saving the old values, so Undo last change puts them back.
Chromebooks Google has no usage date for are left alone, unless you tick Also blank ones Google has no usage date for.
Org units marked Loaners, Repairs, Lost or Testing in your org unit map are never touched, and neither is anyone on the Ignore list.

Every morning (5:45 AM) (new section)

Tick either or both jobs: blank unused Chromebooks, and set the assigned user to the student who last signed in. Then click Save & schedule. The Every morning… button in the “Set it to the last signed-in user” section turns on the second one directly.
It covers whatever “Which Chromebooks” is set to when you click Save & schedule: all Chromebooks, or the org units you chose.
It blanks unused ones first, and then won’t refill those from an old sign-in.
Every run saves a backup, so Undo works. If a run would change an unusually large number of devices, it stops and waits for you to run it by hand once.
Turn off stops the morning run.

This is a separate scheduled task from the “Move it to the student’s school org unit” one (5:50 AM), so you can run either or both.

Before turning on the morning run, click Preview unused and Preview once to check the results. Do it again any time you change the days setting.
